Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- The playback base is packed from the uncut stock before the removal calculation runs again, so each frame shows stock being cut, not the finished part (`crates/app/src/stock_play_worker.rs`). The cause chain (#2181 moved the `PackedBase::of` call after the eikonal pass) is stated correctly and the fix is a one-line move with a comment.
- The eikonal `max(mesh, cut)` law is untouched: only when the base is packed is the mesh layer clean. A wrong base could have hidden removed material; it can now only show more cut, never less.
- The pinning test file `crates/app/tests/stock_play_precalc.rs` checks the precalculated stock against the live cut at every playhead position. I re-ran it on the trial-merge tree with main `c0c92ee86`: 8 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (the heavy-lane twin).
- `docs/decisions/2396-sim-stock-visible.md` records the fix. Body complete: `Changelog:`, `Fixes #2396`, conventional subject, honest "not exercised" list.

## Results, merged with main

Built locally by this lane in a review worktree on Windows; the trial merge with `origin/main` was local only, never pushed.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --test stock_play_precalc` | 8 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored |
| `camcraft-app` lib and the mapped sim suites (this lane's review agent) | pass, 0 failed (213 lib + 25 sim reported) |
| clippy `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -D warnings` | clean, exit 0 (review agent's run) |

The author's marker comments on this PR are not counted here; this is the independent review.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. The one ignored test is the heavy-lane twin; it runs at the cut. Correct per the split law.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 4481c2a06e238ba15791cf4e2e8acc777503a273 -->

Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- The playback worker packs the session base from the uncut stock before the calculation runs (`crates/app/src/stock_play_worker.rs:346-350`). This restores the order from before #2181.
- Safety-floor check (stock simulation): the packed base feeds only the picture. `PackedBase::of` takes `&Stock`, changes only its own lattice, and its code comment says "a picture, never a verdict" (`crates/app/src/stock_view.rs:123-133`). The only consumers of `packed` are the GPU eye (`crates/ui/src/trace/eye.rs:273-278`) and the frame builder (`crates/app/src/stock_play_worker.rs:319-339`). `crates/sim` has no reference to `PackedBase` or a packed view. A collision or gouge check cannot read this data, so the change cannot mask a gouge.
- The cut layer still comes from the live field at each snapshot (`pack_cut(f, ...)`), so the drawn material is the true sim result over a clean base. The picture can show no less cut than before.
- Refusal semantics are unchanged. `PackedBase::of` returns an `Option`; the moved call is not on a refusal path (`stock_play_worker.rs:341-355`). `FieldPlay::view` takes `&self` (`crates/app/src/stock_play.rs:342`), so packing earlier mutates nothing.
- Pinning test reads the packed lattice the eye draws, not only the sparse field. Body is complete: `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #2396` in body and commit, conventional subject, decision record `docs/decisions/2396-sim-stock-visible.md`.

## Results, merged with main (local, Windows; trial merge with origin/main c0c92ee86 was clean)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick` plan (5 steps) | green, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app` lib | 363 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored |
| `stock_play` | 7 passed |
| `stock_play_partial` | 3 passed |
| `stock_play_precalc` | 8 passed, 1 heavy-lane ignored |
| `camcraft-sim` whole crate (safety floor) | 83 binaries: 716 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean, exit 0 |

## Process notes (not blocking)

1. Two review lanes ran on this PR at once. A collaborator review with the same head marker is already posted; this comment confirms it with independent runs. No disagreement between the two.
2. `crates/app/src/stock_play_worker.rs` is 406 lines, just over the ~400-line guideline. This PR adds one line net. No action now.
3. The GPU shader composite is not exercised, as the author states. The test reads the lattice the eye uploads.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
